title: Modern Human Archaeogenetics Overlay (Y-DNA & mtDNA Global Migration Tree)

nodes.name: Mitochondrial Eve (mtDNA L0–L3, ~150–200 kya, Africa)
nodes.role: Most Recent Common Matrilineal Ancestor of All Living Humans
nodes.notes: Every living human carries mitochondrial DNA descended from African matrilineal root L (splitting into L0, L1, L2 across Sub-Saharan Africa and L3 in East Africa, source of the Out-of-Africa expansion ~70 kya).

nodes.name: Y-Chromosomal Adam (Y-DNA A00 / A–BT, ~200–300 kya, Africa)
nodes.role: Most Recent Common Patrilineal Ancestor of All Living Men
nodes.notes: Deepest patrilineal root of humanity (A00 discovered in Cameroon/Central-West Africa; A & B across Southern/East Africa; BT -> CT giving rise to ALL non-African and most African Y-DNA lineages).

nodes.name: Out-of-Africa Dispersal (mtDNA M & N / Y-DNA CT → CF & DE, ~70–55 kya)
nodes.role: Shared Ancestral Bottleneck of All Eurasian, Oceanic & American Peoples
nodes.notes: Small ancestral groups crossed from East Africa via the Bab-el-Mandeb / Sinai corridor carrying mtDNA L3 (-> M, N, R) and Y-DNA CT (-> DE, CF), later encountering Neanderthals (~55 kya) and Denisovans (~45 kya) in Eurasia!

nodes.name: Y-DNA E1b1a (E-V38 — West, Central & Bantu African Expansion)
nodes.role: Primary Patrilineal Corridor of Niger-Congo & Bantu Peoples
nodes.notes: Dominant paternal haplogroup across West, Central, East, and Southern Africa — bridging Yoruba, Benin, Mande/Mali, and Bantu Great Lakes populations!

nodes.name: Y-DNA E1b1b (E-M215 — Horn of Africa, Egypt, Amazigh & Levant)
nodes.notes: Unites the Horn of Africa (Ethiopia/Kush), Ancient Egypt (attested in Ramesses III!), North African Amazigh/Berbers (E-M81), and Natufian Levantines!

nodes.name: Y-DNA J1 (J-M267) & J2 (J-M172) — Fertile Crescent, Semitic & Mediterranean
nodes.notes: J1 expanded across the Arabian Peninsula, Levant, and Mesopotamia (highly enriched in Jewish, Arab, and Assyrian populations — including the Cohen Modal Haplotype!); J2 expanded from the Zagros/Anatolia across Phoenicia, Minoan Crete, Greece, and Etruscan Italy!

nodes.name: Y-DNA G2a — Anatolian Neolithic Farmers (Spread of Agriculture)
nodes.notes: Carried by early Neolithic farmers (including Ötzi the Iceman!) from Anatolia and the Caucasus across the Mediterranean and Central Europe.

nodes.name: Y-DNA R1b (Yamnaya Steppe → Western Europe, Celtic & Italic)
nodes.role: Bronze Age Steppe Expansion into Western Europe
nodes.notes: Expanded dramatically from Pontic-Caspian Steppe Yamnaya/Bell Beaker pastoralists into Central Europe, Italy, Iberia, Britain, and Ireland (accounting for ~80%+ of modern Irish/Celtic paternal lineages!).

nodes.name: Y-DNA R1a (Corded Ware / Sintashta → Indo-Iranian & Slavic)
nodes.notes: Sintashta/Andronovo chariot pastoralists carrying R1a-Z93 expanded southward across Central Asia into the Iranian Plateau and Northern India (~2000–1500 BCE), directly mirroring the shared Vedic-Avestan linguistic & genealogical layer!

nodes.name: Y-DNA I1 & I2 — Paleolithic European & Nordic Corridor
nodes.notes: Ancient pre-Neolithic European haplogroup (sister clade of Near Eastern J via IJ!) that surged across Scandinavia and the Balkans.

nodes.name: Y-DNA H & L — Ancient Indus Valley (Harappan) & South Asian Roots
nodes.role: Indus Valley Civilization & Ancient South Asian Ancestral Layer
nodes.notes: Indus Valley Civilization (Harappa/Rakhigarhi) combined Iranian-plateau farmer ancestry with indigenous South Asian hunter-gatherers (AASI), later admixing with Steppe R1a pastoralists to form modern South Asia!

nodes.name: Y-DNA O2 (O-M122) — Yellow River Neolithic (Sino-Tibetan / East Asia)
nodes.notes: Three major 'super-grandfather' star expansions of Y-DNA O2 around ~6,000–5,000 BP in the Yellow River basin mirror the Neolithic consolidation remembered in the Yan-Huang (Yandi & Huangdi) traditions!

nodes.name: Y-DNA O1a + mtDNA B4a1a1 ('Polynesian Motif' — Taiwan → Lapita → Pacific!)
nodes.notes: Traces the Out-of-Taiwan Austronesian voyage through the Philippines, Lapita Melanesia (admixing with Papuan C1b2a), out to Tonga, Samoa, Hawaii, Aotearoa/New Zealand, and Rapa Nui — even detecting pre-Columbian contact with South America (~1200 CE)!

nodes.name: Y-DNA D (Jōmon Japan/Tibet), C2 (Steppe/Xiongnu) & N (Northern Eurasia)
nodes.role: Inner Asian Steppe & Jōmon-Yayoi Japanese Corridors
nodes.notes: Y-DNA D1a2 represents ancient Jōmon Japan (which admixed with Korean/Yayoi O1b2 arrivals to form modern Japanese!), while C2 & N anchor the Xiongnu, Turkic, and Mongol Steppe confederacies!

nodes.name: Y-DNA Q (Q-M242 → Q-M3) & mtDNA A2/B2/C1/D1 — Beringia to the Americas!
nodes.role: Peopling of North, Central & South America
nodes.notes: Ancestral Native Americans diverged in Siberia/Beringia carrying Y-DNA Q-M3 (sister branch of Eurasian R via P!) and mtDNA A2, B2, C1, D1, rapidly settling North America, Mesoamerica (Maya/Aztec), and the Andes (Inca)!
